decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-177a6106bc02], which says HTTP/3 was moved outside the experimental section. It does not name a configuration key or flag. It also does not say whether the old experimental HTTP/3 option was removed, ignored or still accepted, or what replaces it. The proposed exposure relies on the flag `--experimental.http3` and the Helm values key `experimental.http3`, which the evidence never mentions, and it adds a broad undecidable runtime branch. To decide which environments are exposed, we need the v3 migration guide or the diff for PR #9570, showing the old and new HTTP/3 option names and what happens when the old one is still set.
